scenes.title: Security hands the phone to the Captain
Return the phone and receive the PDF

lines.text: Security fills in the NOTOC form and hands the phone to you, the Captain.
You check and sign on that same phone.
Tap the orange button marked ‘Captain has the phone’.
Review each entry on the form and check the ‘Loaded by’ name.
If anything is wrong, tap ‘Something is wrong’ and give the phone back to Security for correction.
If everything is correct, type your own name in ‘Acknowledged by’.
If you need to sign again, tap ‘Clear’.
When your signature is ready, tap ‘Confirm my signature’.
When the screen asks, give the phone back to Security.
Security signs and saves the record.
The signed PDF has a Record ID.
AirAsia Security keeps it in a restricted folder and logs the record.
Security emails you a copy for your records.
